A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same KNO research and contain 34 readable pages, including Appendices A and B. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of the text, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v3 reports original KNO benchmark errors and training/inference timings in Section 4, plus super-resolution results and ablations in Appendix A.

after.justification: v4 retains those original KNO experiments, timing measurements, super-resolution results, and appendix ablations.

M1.justification: The KNO formulation and discretization in Section 2 and Appendix A.1 are identical, including kernel choices, dimension-wise factorization, interpolation, and channel mixing.

E1.justification: The seven benchmarks in Table 1 and the Darcy zero-shot super-resolution scenario in Appendix A.1.5 are unchanged, including their domains and input/output tasks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the main and appendix experiments. The same FNO/Geo-FNO, GNOT, Transolver, and KM comparisons are retained, with the same unavailable entries.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix A retain the same splits, preprocessing, metrics, hyperparameter searches, and training budgets, including 10,000 epochs generally and 500 for NS-Pipe.

E4.justification: The super-resolution demonstration and all Appendix A.7 ablations are unchanged, including kernel properties, matrix-valued kernel structure, model size, component removal, quadrature, and factorization.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard errors across four randomly initialized training runs. Table 8 and the appendix run-count and uncertainty disclosures are unchanged.

E6.justification: All reported results match, including accuracy in Tables 2 and 8, parameter counts in Table 4, timings in Tables 5–6, ablations in Tables 10–18, and graphical predictions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Theorems 3.1 and 3.2, their assumptions, and the proofs and lemmas in Appendix B are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about universal approximation, geometric flexibility, competitive accuracy, and reduced parameter and memory requirements.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning kernel expressiveness and noise, quadrature and factorization tradeoffs, implementation inefficiencies, and future theoretical and computational work are identical.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, and code/data access information are unchanged. The newly added OpenReview link is publication metadata and does not revise the stated reproducibility resources.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning in Section 1.1 are unchanged. Correcting Pflüger's name in the PDEBench reference is a bibliographic spelling correction, not a change in cited work.

P1.justification: v4 adds publication-status text and an OpenReview line, updates the arXiv version/date, and corrects Pflüger's name. The scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: v4 adds a TMLR running header throughout and an OpenReview line on the first page, slightly repositioning the abstract heading. The corrected reference rewraps locally; all figures and tables retain their displays and placement.

improvement.justification: v4 adds publication/review metadata and corrects one bibliographic name. These small editorial refinements leave the scientific exposition, evidence, reproducibility, and substantive strengths and limitations unchanged, producing no meaningful overall quality difference.
